products.name: Vulcan
products.tagline: One console over every monitoring tool you already run
products.description: An indigenous operations layer that reads existing monitoring tools, resolves their signals into one canonical picture and prioritizes what needs attention.
products.problemSolved: Operations teams receive fragmented and duplicated signals from multiple monitoring tools, making it difficult to see the real incident and decide what needs attention.
features: Read-only integration with existing monitoring tools
benefits: A single operational view across existing tools
Transparent reasons for held or escalated alarms
products.deploymentModel: Offline bundle using read-only service accounts, with no required external license, update or model endpoint.
products.status: Decision core in service; multi-source console prototype; additional adapters, calibrated model, operator assistant and high availability in development.
